sections.title: 1. Introduction
sections.content: BravoBall (the "App") is a soccer training app operated by Conklin Official LLC ("we", "us"). This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, who can see it, which service providers process it for us, and the choices you have. If you have questions, contact us at team@conklinofficial.com.

sections.title: 2. Who BravoBall Is For
sections.content: Players who are at least 13 years old can create a BravoBall account themselves. Children under 13 can use BravoBall only through the parental consent process described in section 3. Players under 18 should review this policy with a parent or guardian before signing up.

sections.title: 3. Children's Privacy
sections.content:
We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13 without verifiable parental consent. We ask a parent or guardian for that consent by email, using a method known as "email plus".

Asking for consent: if a player tells us they are 12 or under, we ask for a parent or guardian's email address and the child's first name or nickname only. We collect these only to ask for consent. We then email the parent or guardian an explanation of what BravoBall collects and how we use it, a link to this Privacy Policy, and links to approve or decline. These links expire and work only once.

Before a parent approves: we hold only the parent's email, the child's first name or nickname, and the training answers the child gave during setup (such as position, age range and skill level), so the account is ready if the parent approves. The child can train on that device; their training activity stays on the device. We do not send analytics, show the child on leaderboards, allow friends, or allow joining a coach's team.

If a parent declines or does not respond: if the parent or guardian declines, or does not respond within 7 days, we delete the pending account along with the parent's email address and the child's name.

When a parent approves: we record the time of approval and the IP address and browser information (user agent) used to approve, as our record of consent. We then send the parent or guardian a confirmation email; this confirmation is the "plus" in "email plus".

After approval: the child's account stores the training preferences and progress needed to run the App. We do not send the child's personal information to analytics providers (product analytics stay off for child accounts), the child is hidden from the world leaderboard by default, and friends stay off. The child may join a coach's team; that coach can then see the information described in section 6.

Parental rights: a parent or guardian can revoke consent at any time using the link in the confirmation email, which deletes the child's account and associated data. A parent or guardian can also contact us at team@conklinofficial.com to review or delete their child's personal information or to refuse further collection or use of it.

If we learn that we have collected personal information from a child under 13 without verifiable parental consent, we will delete it.

sections.title: 4. Information We Collect
sections.content:
Account information: your email address, a username, and a password (stored only in hashed form). If you sign in with Google or Apple, we receive your email address (or an Apple private relay address) and an account identifier from that provider. Apart from a child's first name or nickname during parental consent (section 3), the player app does not ask for your real name.

Parental consent (children under 13 only): a parent or guardian's email address, the child's first name or nickname, and our record of the parent's approval (time, IP address, and browser information). See section 3.

Training profile: the answers you give during setup, such as your age range, position, training experience, goals, strengths, areas to improve, available equipment, where you train, session length, training and game days, and how you heard about BravoBall.

Training activity: sessions and drills you complete, your training plan and calendar, streaks, points, saved drills, custom drills you create, and your chosen avatar. Videos you attach to custom drills stay on your device and are not uploaded.

Notifications: your notification settings, time zone, and a push notification token for your device.

Usage and device data: app events (for example, which screens you open and which sessions you finish), device model, operating system, app version, approximate location derived from your IP address, and crash and error reports.

We do not collect your phone number, contacts, photos, or precise location.

sections.title: 5. How We Use Your Information
sections.content: We use your information to: (a) create your account and keep it secure; (b) build personalized training sessions and plans; (c) track your progress, streaks, and points; (d) send training reminders and account emails such as password resets; (e) show leaderboards, friends, and team features; and (f) understand how the App is used so we can fix bugs and improve it. We do not use your information for advertising, and the App does not show ads.

sections.title: 6. What Other Users Can See
sections.content:
World leaderboard: your username, avatar, points, and number of completed sessions can appear on the world leaderboard, which other BravoBall users can see. You can hide yourself from the world leaderboard at any time in Profile > Manage Account > Privacy. New accounts get a random username that is not based on your email.

Friends: people you accept as friends can see your username, email address, avatar, points, rank, streaks, completed sessions, total training time, favorite drill, and when you last trained.

Coaches and teams: if you join a team with a team code or link, or a coach adds you to their team, that coach can see your username, email address, avatar, streaks, completed sessions, training minutes, and the drills in the sessions you complete. To leave a team, ask your coach to remove you or contact us. If a coach deletes their account, their team is removed and its players are simply taken off the team; the players' own accounts and data are not affected.

Children under 13: child accounts are hidden from the world leaderboard by default and cannot use friends. A child may join a coach's team, and that coach sees the information described above.

Choose a username that does not include your real name or other personal details. You can change it in Profile > Manage Account.

sections.title: 7. Service Providers We Use
sections.content:
We do not sell or rent your personal information. We share it only with service providers that run parts of the App for us, under their terms, and only for that purpose:

• Render: hosts our servers and database.
• PostHog: product analytics and crash and error reporting.
• Google Firebase: push notifications (Firebase Cloud Messaging) and sign-in with Google or Apple (Firebase Authentication).
• Google Sign-In and Sign in with Apple: only if you choose to sign in with them.
• SendGrid (Twilio): sends account emails such as password resets and parental consent emails.
• Apple App Store and Google Play: distribute the App and show the optional rating prompt.

We may also disclose information if required by law or to protect the safety of our users.

sections.title: 8. Data Security
sections.content: We use encrypted connections (HTTPS) between the App and our servers, store passwords only in hashed form, and limit access to our systems. No method of storage or transmission is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.title: 9. Data Retention and Deleting Your Account
sections.content: We keep your information for as long as your account exists. You can delete your account at any time in the App under Profile > Manage Account > Delete Account. Deleting your account removes your profile, training history, friend connections, team memberships, and related data from our active systems; copies may remain in routine backups for a limited time before they are overwritten. You can also ask us to delete your account by emailing team@conklinofficial.com.

sections.title: 10. Your Choices and Rights
sections.content: You can update your username, email address, password, avatar, and training preferences in the App, and turn notifications on or off in Profile settings or your device settings. You may also ask us to access, correct, or delete your personal information by emailing team@conklinofficial.com. A parent or guardian of a player under 18 may make these requests on the player's behalf.

sections.title: 11. International Data Transfers
sections.content: BravoBall and its service providers process information primarily in the United States. If you use BravoBall from another country, your information will be transferred to and processed in the United States.

sections.title: 12. Changes to This Policy
sections.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will post the updated policy in the App and change the "Last updated" date. If we make material changes, we will tell you in the App before they take effect.

sections.title: 13. Contact Us
sections.content: If you have any questions or requests about this Privacy Policy or your information, contact us at team@conklinofficial.com.
